summary: Extract a dependency-free local Discovery evidence storage/resolution work item with bounded implementation deliverables and fixture acceptance.
rationale: The bounded inventory did not identify an evidence writer or exact-revision resolver. UBU-Q0191 isolates that smaller implementation/mapping task so it can produce local evidence without first completing review, admission and exchange. UBU-Q0166 retains its existing closure alternatives and all recorded limitations.

+## UBU-D0388: Isolate the local Discovery evidence implementation slice
+
+**Status:** Accepted → DESIGN.md §21.1.1; OPEN_QUESTIONS.md `UBU-Q0191`. Narrows `UBU-Q0166` after `UBU-D0386` without claiming compatibility evidence.
+
+Extract the unidentified evidence writer and revision resolver into `UBU-Q0191`, a smaller Phase 2 implementation/mapping question with no unresolved-question dependencies. Deliver one local, policy-checked evidence write/read path and resolved candidate field-to-claim links under the bounded acceptance scope in §21.1.1. `UBU-D0320` and `UBU-D0321` already supply its semantics; completing normalization, rendered review, admission and exchange is not a prerequisite to answering this storage/resolution slice.
+
+Review missing implementation separately and pin the resulting code before reporting fixtures. Existing generic carriers are candidates for investigation, not selected mappings. Neither a new Discovery kind nor reuse of a native object label merely to pass a closed validator is authorized. A missing implementation or failed carrier choice does not demonstrate a governing schema gap.
+
+`UBU-Q0166` remains Open with its existing full conformance or demonstrated-gap closure routes. A passing `UBU-Q0191` result supplies only bounded evidence for that gate; it enables no producer/adapter and repairs none of the recorded normalization, presentation or client limitations. No schema, enum, FactProvenance field, dependency pin or migration change is made here.

 `DiscoveryEvidenceItem` remains the logical record specified by §12.2 and `UBU-D0320`. This inspection constructs, stores and resolves no complete evidence revision or candidate field-to-claim link; that fixture path remains unexecuted. The search excludes other checkouts, untracked files and alternate implementations. Failure to locate a dedicated path cannot establish that every compliant existing payload/ref mapping fails; generic carrier and artifact-format choices still require their own validation and complete path evidence.
 
 Before the next fidelity run, identify the concrete evidence writer, revision-addressed reader/resolver, current policy boundary and candidate/field/claim host paths for one complete permitted specimen. Supply missing implementation through separately reviewed work and recheck affected revisions before relying on it. Then run the existing profile/ref rejection, normalization, service, rendered-review, recovery and authorized-exchange fixtures. No new profile, canonical object, candidate kind, reference grammar or closure criterion is selected. `UBU-Q0166` stays Open; the previously recorded normalization, presentation and client limitations remain unrepaired, and no governing schema gap is demonstrated.
+
+**Local evidence implementation slice (`UBU-D0388`; `UBU-Q0191`).** Separate the missing local write/read/resolution path from the remaining conformance investigation. This slice can close independently of executable normalization, rendered review, admission and exchange; those remain under `UBU-Q0166`. Implement or identify the following path through separately reviewed work, then establish evidence at its actual revisions:
+
+| Deliverable | Bounded acceptance evidence |
+|---|---|
+| Host mapping and callable path | Name the concrete writer, durable carrier/table or payload-ref paths, exact-revision reader/resolver and current policy-check functions. Map the logical evidence id/version, source/session bindings, claims/qualifications, ancestry and candidate field links to exact host paths. Pin implementation, schemas/serializers, store and policy configuration; generic JSON acceptance or a fixture-local lookup dictionary cannot substitute for the host implementation. |
+| Materialized local fixture | Store complete permitted evidence `E1@v1` with separately attributed observation and inference, differing reported/unreported confidence, incompatible alternatives and source ancestry; store a separately attributed contradicting claim in `E2@v1`. Persist a supported native candidate whose field mapping cites exact claims in both revisions. Resolve those links through the actual reader and compare retrieved structured content with independent exact expectations. Resolve the referenced source/session records too; opaque tokens alone do not pass. These labels are fixture aliases, not a new reference grammar or candidate kind. |
+| Revision and replay controls | Append a linked correction/replacement without rewriting `E1@v1`; resolve both exact revisions and show that an existing field link is not silently rebound to the latest content. Reopen storage and repeat the read and identical-key write; demonstrate one retained operation and rejection of changed-content key reuse. Label pool reconnect separately from process/crash recovery. |
+| Invalid or unavailable bindings | Exercise unknown profile, missing evidence revision, missing claim key and policy denial after an earlier permitted read. The resolver must withhold a usable binding without substituting latest content, dropping qualifications or disclosing denied content/existence. Policy-permitted unresolved evidence retention may precede that refusal; generic storage acceptance is not itself an adapter-validation failure. |
+
+Publish serialized inputs, retrieved outputs, expected/observed link resolutions and the reproducible harness with pins. Declare numeric representations and use exact-value comparisons independent of the decoder being tested under `UBU-D0379`; fixture-local payload keys do not amend the companion profile. Candidate persistence may bypass normalization for this bounded control only if that bypass is explicit. Evidence/link resolution admits no proposed world-state effect; record all writes so evidence/replay metadata cannot mask a canonical mutation.
+
+No part of this slice is reported executed here. Its acceptance supplies a local evidence-path result, not a complete perceptual adapter mapping. Unexecuted HTTP/disclosure, normalization, rendered review, admission, crash recovery, partial acceptance, retention and authorized-exchange paths remain explicit under `UBU-Q0166`'s existing gate. An implementation need is distinct from a governing contract restriction; any required schema/type/store change still needs separate versioned review under `UBU-D0321`.
 
 **Supported operations.** Validate the native proposal against an already-supported candidate kind and ordinary admission operation before enqueueing an executable review proposal. Unresolved targets, unsupported object kinds and perceptual values without a supported adapter remain Discovery review evidence with the limitation visible; they cannot fall through to a generic mutation executor. `UniverseTarget` advice remains name-only under `UBU-D0296`: it cannot carry, default or admit a perceptual value. The operator may author a value through the ordinary assertion/measurement form linked to the evidence. Future perceptual value-candidate support requires its separately reviewed versioned adapter; this contract does not enable it. Intent, affect, Preferences, completion/effect claims and later-phase Resources/Skills/Techniques retain their existing source and admission gates.

 ## UBU-Q0166: Preserve perceptual qualifiers alongside the closed provenance enum
 
 Status: Open Priority: MVP important Phase: Phase 2 Decision type: Data model Auto-choice eligibility: Human approval required Importance score: TBD Automation-likelihood score: TBD Risk score: TBD Answerability score: 100 Depends on: None Blocks: None Resolved by: None Last scored: 2026-10-19 Scored from commit: None
 
 ### Question
 
 Which revision-pinned host mappings preserve the claim-level qualifications specified by `UBU-D0321` through validation, serialization, storage, review and authorized exchange, and does a failed mapping demonstrate a schema gap requiring separate versioned review?
 
 ### Current direction
 
 Delta §17.4. `UBU-D0293` decides kind mapping; `UBU-D0320` decides observation/admission bindings; `UBU-D0321` specifies claim-level qualifier content, field/evidence links and fidelity fixtures. The remaining work is a revision-pinned host field/payload mapping and round-trip evidence from the actual validators, serializers, store/review and exchange paths. Measured remains an instrument/reading, derived a computation from facts, and proposed an unconfirmed candidate. Do not infer host compatibility from prose payload slots. A demonstrated gap requires separate versioned chain review; no schema, pin or migration change is made here. `UBU-D0323` records bounded candidate link-carrier checks and source-inspected downstream limitations. Full claims/qualifiers and resolved evidence revisions still need fixtures through the actual Discovery, normalization, store/review, admission and authorized-exchange paths. A rejected direct field mapping alone does not establish a schema gap.
 
 `UBU-D0334` extends those probes to actual persistence/reload/replay and direct review API reads, with a minimal runtime reproduction of inline qualifier loss in `precondition_review::vet_result`. The rejected normalized-proposal alternative and this implementation loss do not establish that all compliant existing payload/ref mappings fail. Repair or validate that branch before relying on it; the full qualifier/evidence and policy-authorized paths remain the enablement gate.
 
 `UBU-D0360` adds opaque string-reference controls that survive core round trips and the tested normalization branch. The first token's normalized output also survives direct storage/replay/API reads. The unresolved alternate token also receives native `ok`; no manifest or evidence revision is resolved. Treat these as carrier evidence only, not an approved field-provenance mapping or qualifier-preservation result. The inline loss remains unrepaired.
 
 `UBU-D0366` exercises actual native enqueue and admission services. Both unresolved tokens can accompany an admitted synthetic precondition removal; known and unknown inline profiles are discarded before enqueue and their native removals also admit. The changed-precondition control rejects without an effect. These controls establish native behavior, not qualifier-aware admission: resolved content, profile/ref/policy validation and complete reviewed evidence links remain required.
 
 `UBU-D0373` adds mounted Review component controls with a mocked API/client boundary. Retained known and unknown inline specimens yield identical article DOM to the baseline; opaque refs appear only as strings, and Admit invokes the mock in every control. This establishes a separate presentation limitation, without full qualifier content, actual admission or an end-to-end mapping.
 
 `UBU-D0379` adds actual JavaScript client/plugin probes with mocked native IPC: an exact synthetic integer changes during response JSON decoding, while raw text and string controls survive. Using the same decoder for input/output comparison masks the loss. Include independent exact-value checks and the client numeric domain in the pinned mapping; no encoding or adapter is approved.
 
 `UBU-D0385` supplies a compact evidence index and retained client request-binding reproduction in §21.1.1. The index preserves specimen and harness boundaries; synthetic version rounding establishes no native admission or practical stale approval. Next investigate a complete Discovery evidence revision and resolved candidate/field links, then adapter rejection and actual service/review paths under the existing policy-bounded mapping gate.
 
 `UBU-D0386` records a source-only Discovery host-path inventory at the same five revisions. No dedicated evidence implementation or complete revision resolver was located in its bounded tracked-source scope. Generic carriers remain unqualified; identify the concrete evidence write/read/resolution and candidate field-to-claim paths before the complete fixture run. This finding establishes no governing schema gap.
 
 ### Resolution
 
 Open. `UBU-D0321` answers preservation requirements; `UBU-D0323` records the initial synthetic carrier probes. `UBU-D0334` adds actual direct SQLite close/reopen/replay and review API controls, and reproduces qualifier loss in the tested precondition-review normalization branch despite a native `ok` result. This disqualifies that mapping through that branch, without establishing a governing schema gap. `UBU-D0360` additionally records retention of opaque reference strings through normalization and, for the first specimen, direct persistence/API controls. The alternate token remains unresolved; no manifest or qualifier content is resolved. Complete Discovery claim/qualifier mappings, adapter profile/ref validation, faithful normalization and rendered review, admission and authorized-exchange fixtures remain outstanding. Close only with the full pinned mapping and fixture evidence, or a minimally reproduced host-contract gap routed to a separate versioned change. No passing adapter or actual schema gap is established.
 
 `UBU-D0366` adds actual controller enqueue/native-admission controls and native stale-value/old-candidate-version rejection. It demonstrates no resolved manifest or qualifier-preserving admission, and makes no repair or schema-gap claim. The full existing enablement gate remains outstanding; this question stays Open.
 
 `UBU-D0373` upgrades the generic precondition-review card's UI source inspection to bounded mounted DOM/click evidence. It makes no repair or full-preservation claim; resolved qualifier presentation, actual review/admission and authorized exchange remain outstanding. This question stays Open.
 
 `UBU-D0379` records a separate numeric-fidelity limitation at the tested client decoder and a comparison that falsely reports preservation when both sides use that decoder. The numeric carrier controls resolve no evidence and test no deployed WebView, native admission or exchange. Exact numeric representations and full qualifier preservation remain unqualified; this question stays Open.
 
 `UBU-D0385` retains the request-binding probe source/results and indexes the existing evidence without replacing closure criteria. No complete qualifier mapping, repair, passing adapter or governing schema gap is established; this question stays Open.
 
 `UBU-D0386` bounds the unidentified Discovery implementation path to its inspected scope; it executes no complete Discovery fixture and approves no carrier mapping. The full existing gate remains outstanding; this question stays Open.
 
+`UBU-D0388` extracts the local evidence writer/revision-resolver implementation slice into dependency-free `UBU-Q0191`. That smaller question can supply bounded storage/resolution evidence without first completing the downstream adapter paths. It establishes no passing result; this question retains its existing full-conformance or demonstrated-gap closure routes and stays Open.

+## UBU-Q0191: Local revision-addressed Discovery evidence storage and resolution
+
+Status: Open Priority: MVP important Phase: Phase 2 Decision type: Data model Auto-choice eligibility: Human approval required Importance score: TBD Automation-likelihood score: TBD Risk score: TBD Answerability score: TBD Depends on: None Blocks: None Resolved by: None Last scored: Never Scored from commit: None
+
+### Question
+
+Which concrete local host writer, durable representation, exact-revision reader/resolver and current policy checks can retain one complete Discovery evidence fixture and resolve its candidate field-to-claim links under `UBU-D0320`/`UBU-D0321`?
+
+### Current direction
+
+Extracted from `UBU-Q0166` by `UBU-D0388` after `UBU-D0386` could not identify the implementation path in its bounded source inventory. Use DESIGN.md §21.1.1's local evidence implementation slice: identify or separately implement the path, pin it, materialize complete evidence and candidate links, and execute local fidelity, exact-revision, correction/replay and invalid/unavailable-binding controls. Publish exact field paths, called functions, inputs, readbacks and a reproducible harness. An in-memory reference dictionary, arbitrary JSON or retained opaque strings cannot establish the host resolver.
+
+This question has no unresolved-question dependencies. It requires no model producer, mounted UI, executable admission or exchange result; any bypassed or unexecuted path must be named. Those remaining paths and full adapter qualification stay in `UBU-Q0166`. Do not invent a Discovery kind, mislabel evidence as an unrelated native object or infer a schema gap from absent implementation. Required host-contract changes follow separate versioned review.
+
+### Resolution
+
+Open. No implementation or passing local fixture is established. Close on the bounded mapping and executed controls above; the resulting decision must state its pins and limits. Closing this slice neither closes `UBU-Q0166` nor enables a producer/adapter.
